$comment: Guardrails for UNATTENDED autonomous runs. Pass via `claude --settings orchestrator/process/harness/settings.autonomous.json` (or use in the GitHub Action). Do NOT make this the always-on project settings — the Stop hook would fire on every interactive turn. Run inside a sandbox/container.

hooks.$comment: Advisory risk classifier (OpenHands security_risk style) — logs HIGH-risk (contract/schema/migration/control) edits to harness/risk.log so a human reviews them. Set HARNESS_RISK_ADVISORY=0 to BLOCK instead of warn.
Every turn must end with the manifest reconciling to reality — no silent drift.
